title: Advanced Redstone Torch
description:
Unlike a normal redstone torch which just emits either a redstone signal of 15 or 0 with an advanced one you can configure the signal strength for the two states freely. It's green while powered and red while unpowered.

Right click it to open a gui with a "Green Strength" and a "Red Strength" row. The - and + buttons change the value by 1, from 0 to 15. By default the red state emits 15 and the green state emits 0. It can be placed on the floor or on walls and burns out like a normal redstone torch if it is toggled too quickly.
